data.name: 7 Days To Think About It
data.detailed_description:
After finishing your studies and working non-stop for five years, you still feel stuck in life.

Should you look for a job or pursue your dream project?

The choice is yours, but it's a hard one.

Suddenly, a notification pops up on your computer, waking you up - your friends want to meet up tonight to help you clear your mind.

Is this a waste of time? Is this just a distraction?

One thing is clear - you're now stuck at home, overthinking whether to go out or not today.

You have 7 days to think about it.

KEY FEATURES

  • A house with randomised furniture - memorise what you see and answer a "Yes" or "No" question;

  • Atmospheric 3D aesthetic with an eerie, retro vibe;

  • 3 endings to discover;

  • 2 unlockable extra game modes + an endgame Secret Story.
